result.note: Tests the India–Maldives FTA's first round, the parallel BIT and India's trading-partner rank.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India–Maldives economic ties as of July 2026:
items: The first round of India–Maldives Free Trade Agreement talks covered eight policy areas.
A Bilateral Investment Treaty is being pursued in parallel with the Free Trade Agreement.
India is the Maldives' largest trading partner.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The third statement is wrong because India is the Maldives' second-largest trading partner, not its largest. Bilateral trade rose 13.54 per cent to USD 771.76 million in 2025-26, and on 8 July 2026 the two commerce ministers agreed to expedite both the FTA and the BIT.
questions.source: India is the Maldives' second-largest trading partner, with bilateral trade reaching USD 771.76 million in 2025-26, up 13.54 per cent from USD 679.70 million the year before.
